name: Common Sun
summary: A civic festival identity that turns a public programme into a welcoming printed broadside. Tall display lettering, a half-sun and stepped margins give practical event information a celebratory frame.

typography.usage: Condensed uppercase headlines and short wayfinding labels; leave space above the date band.
Programme details, access information and compact controls; regular and bold only.

recognitionRules: Frame a stacked Anton headline with the source’s stepped vertical rules; keep the text clear of the steps.
Use the 17-ray semicircular fan and horizon sun as large edge ornaments, never behind programme copy.
Set dates on a horizontal band and make time, session title and venue separate readable fields.
Keep pine ink on warm paper for reading; brass is a decorative line color, not small body text.
In print, remove filters and ornamental margins so the complete chronological programme remains visible.

quote: Come for one session. Stay for the afternoon. Find the time, place and access details before you set out.
rightsSummary: Original logo SVGs, transparent PNGs and licensed Anton/Arimo fonts are included.
logoDirection: Use COMMON SUN in condensed uppercase with a low semicircle rising from one horizontal rule. Retain an open horizon rather than enclosing the mark in a generic badge. The source fan is supporting artwork; a simplified half-sun is the new mark.
invariants: Frame a stacked Anton headline with the source’s stepped vertical rules; keep the text clear of the steps.
Use the 17-ray semicircular fan and horizon sun as large edge ornaments, never behind programme copy.
Set dates on a horizontal band and make time, session title and venue separate readable fields.
adaptations: Use the full fan on posters and a single half-sun on small digital headers.
Adapt the date line to each event; preserve the paper, pine and condensed type relationship.
